summary.text: Vince Deeds is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 10 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney and pastor, he also served as director of school safety for Greenbrier County Schools.

paragraphs.text: Vince Deeds was born in Beckley, West Virginia, and graduated from Hinton High School in 1988.
He earned a B.S. in psychology and political science from Virginia Tech in 1992 and a master's degree in psychology from the University of Virginia in 2008.
Deeds took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2022, succeeding Stephen Baldwin.

In the 2025-2026 session he serves as vice chair of the Senate Health and Human Resources Committee and of the Natural Resources Committee, and sits on the Agriculture, Education, Judiciary, Military and Workforce committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
